to.text: During any search for the exact requested object (or for the desklamp once the target is in hand), treat the search as coverage of distinct candidate receptacles rather than a loop over a few. When the current observation shows the requested item is absent, move to a currently listed receptacle absent from the recent observations, while retaining the existing rule to open a closed cabinet/drawer/fridge on arrival and inspect its contents. Sweep a numbered series of same-type containers in one direction without returning to earlier ones; when recent observations show repeated empty locations in that series, try a different receptacle type (e.g., from drawers to cabinets, countertops, fridge, shelves, or sinkbasin) before re-entering the series. Use the most recent observations to notice when the next move would revisit a receptacle just left empty or repeat the same small set of locations, and in that case choose a different uninspected candidate. This is coverage for finding the exact target within the step budget; it does not permit picking up, conditioning, or placing a substitute object.
